notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (exit 0, evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run retriage-drivers-1-060, reviewed_by stays null; no hardware was attached, no hardware or sim backend was run, and no human reviewed or tested anything. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's family is python-object and its helper is PythonObjectDriver. The upstream entry is a plain Python class, not a Gymnasium environment and not a config-only command table: WheelLeggedEnv has no action_space, observation_space, env_id or seed method, and its step returns a five-tuple whose observation is a 286-value row. This package is a direct Driver over locomotion.wheel_legged_env:WheelLeggedEnv with the package fake, which preserves the native step and reset calls and the terminal flags; the card's direct-driver decision is unchanged. The upstream environment was not run: it needs a source build of Genesis from the main branch (README.md:11-13), PyTorch, OpenCV, pygame and the 123 MB of MJCF/URDF/terrain assets (pyproject.toml:8-14), plus the GPU backend the training script initializes (locomotion/wheel_legged_train.py:281). The fake backend is this package's pure Python analytic stand-in (fake.py), not a recording and not the upstream simulator, and it was never compared with upstream. It models one environment instance, the 8-value action, the 10 ms tick, the full 286-value observation layout (9 * 28 history + 28 current + 6 commands), a one-step action latency and the episode length, but no Genesis engine, rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, terrain, sensors, reward terms, domain randomization or rendering; those are in the fidelity gaps. The real environment is vectorized (the training script defaults to 8192 environments, locomotion/wheel_legged_train.py:277); only one instance is exposed and no observation array is reduced. Only catalogue classes are bound: cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1. cap.world.seed.v1 is not bound because WheelLeggedEnv defines no seed method; the reset action accepts an optional seed and seeds Python random, NumPy and Torch before calling the native reset (default 0), and the seed read reports the last reset seed. The step action values are bounded to -100.0 .. 100.0 from the training configuration's clip_actions (locomotion/wheel_legged_train.py:160) and the native torch.clip at locomotion/wheel_legged_env.py:392; one G4.REF_VALUE warning remains because the cited line shows only the positive literal 100.0, not the negated -100.0. The negative end is the negation in the clip call, and no clip_actions line of the clone shows -100.0; the driver Limit reason and facts.md record it. NOT COVERED: the Genesis physics and the upstream simulator, the MJCF/URDF robot and terrain models, rendering, the upstream reward terms and domain randomization, vectorized multi-environment operation, the auto-reset inside the native step when train_mode is true (the driver reports terminated/truncated and requires an explicit cap.world.reset.v1 instead), the upstream reset's stale observation (reset returns the existing obs_buf; the fake returns a fresh one), snapshot/restore, and the sim backend (not declared or run). No physical device is modelled. Only the default configuration of locomotion/wheel_legged_train.py get_cfgs is covered; another env_cfg changes the action clip and observation layout. The package uses no extension ids, so catalogue_requests is empty and omitted. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest line of the last run.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review compared the WheelLeggedEnv API, citations, limits, lockstep stop behavior, provenance and MIT license with the pinned clone. In driver.py, replaced the signed interval's unresolved provenance warning with operator_required, mapped pure timeouts to truncation, rejected missing/nonfinite native scalars and unsupported result shapes, and corrected two fact citations. Added the fake-only site-limits.example.json overlay and regression coverage in test_driver.py, and corrected facts.md. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; fake G1-G9 pass without warnings. Strict collection flags only RESULT_DIGEST_STALE because the author RESULT digest is intentionally unchanged; the orchestrator must refresh it. For the human reviewer: Only the F0 fake is served; the example action overlay is not a deployment limit. A future live factory must supply all configurations, restrict num_envs to one and place the action tensor on the Genesis device. Reset seeds process-wide RNGs; upstream reset can return stale observation buffers, and training-mode step auto-resets before returning. Those live paths remain unexecuted.
